generalCriterionList.description: 1)Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable. (2) Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory. (3) It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

4)The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end. (5) EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection. (6) Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

7)Recent and relevant Certificates and details shall be furnished & Contractor Conditional tenders are not accepted. (8) Tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate 25% of the amount put to tender in single work from the competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer (District Level Officer) and scan the original certificated and attach the scanned file to the tender. The original certificate shall be produced at the time of opening of Tenders. (Last 5 financial years) (9) Third party consultants may be engaged for checking quality and quantity of work and to prevent any misuse. Proper reporting methods, through these agencies and their comments to be reviewed / addressed immediately at District level. Quality of work is of most importance.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

10)If any dates mentioned above happens to be a holiday, the next working day and the same time and venue holds good in lieu of the date mentioned. (11) The contractor should scan the work done certificate, TIN number, PAN and Registration certificates and other documents. If not scanned above certificates such tenders will be rejected. (12) As per Karnatka State Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Blore dated 01.01.07 and Government letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.07, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare Fund. & Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt Orders.

13)The authority competent to accept the tenders shall have the right of rejecting all or any of tenders without assigning any reasons and will not be bound to accept the lowest tenders. (14) Materials like pipe, CI pipe, cement aggregate sand etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and shall be of standered quality as per IS specifications and should get tested by the quality control authority before used to the work at his own cost. (15) The work will be placed under third party inspection.
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

16)The lowest bidder will furnish security deposit & Below amount before the work order is given or 20 days from the date of acceptance whichever is earlier(DD/FDR). (17) The contractor should have yearly turnover not less than the Amount put to Tender in any one financial years out of last 5 financial years. i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26 (Turn over Certificate) (Certified by Chartered Accountant) (With UDIN No) (18) The contractor should upload the Line of Credit for value not less than 30% of the Amount put to Tender.

19)Each Tenderer shall own or make arrangements for procuring the machineries required for executing the work & all the materials should be brought and used by the contractors and materials will not be supplied from the Department. (20) The work should be carried out in accordance with the standard specifications specified by the department. Maintenance period from the contractor for the above works is 1 year from the date of completion of work.

21)The work should be executed strictly as per the tender specification mentioned. Contractor should arrange for quality check at different stage of work for quality assurance as per direction of Engineer-in-charge during the work in progress and after completion. If any failures found the cost will be recovered from the contractor and will be recommended for black listing immediately. (22) All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

23)Contractor should made an agreement within 90 days of tender acceptance date and work should be carried out with in the 1 week time after agreement. If not tender will be cancelled at the contractors own risk and cost. (24) The contractor must scan the Assessed available tender capacity ( AxNx5 - B ) (25) Any over writing of civil engineering words and measurements should be clarified the considered department ( No claims should be considered)

26)Acceptence / Cancellation of the works are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same. (27) Corrigendums / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only.More details should be collected from the office at working hours. (28)The contractor who bid under reservation works (SC&ST) should submitte the cast retificate & residentional proof ( atleast for 10 years in Karnatak) as per the rules of Govt of Karnataka No: FD 876 Exp-12/2017, Bengaluru, Dated : 15-09-2017

29)The Bidder should Quote the rate with out GST. (30) All the items of work mentioned in Schedule-B are inclusive of all lead and lifts, incidental charges etc., work should be carried out as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge.

itemList.description: Providing and fixing  Steel work in built up tubular (round, square or rectangular hollow tubes etc.) trusses etc., including cutting, hoisting, fixing in position and  applying  a  priming  coat  of  approved  steel  primer,  including welding and bolted with special shaped washers etc. complete. Hot finished welded type tubes  including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge. etc complete with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and fixing DI Resilient seated soft sealing SLUICE VALVE of variouis dia. with body bonnet of Ductile Iron (DI) conforming ti IS-1865 with the latest amendments and of grade GGG 40/50, shaft of stainless steel, wedge fully rubber lined with EDPM seals of NBR and the valves should be vacum tight and 100% leak proof with face to face dimensions as per IS 14846-2000 with the latest amendments only. The stem sealing should be with toroidal sealing rings (minimum 2 " O " rings). Body and bonnet should be coated with Electrostatically applied Epoxy Powder Coating with minimum coating thickness of 250 micron both inside and outside. The rate is inclusive of cost of valves, T.P set, galvanized bolts & nuts and rubber insertions etc. but excluding earth work. For PN-10:  (Note: TP set should be considered only for DI pipes estimate. For MS pipes estimates, TP sets cost of corresponding dia shall be deducted from the SR rates of valves and provision for corresponding dia MS flanges should be made in the estimate.) etc. complete. 80 mm dia etc complete with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and fixing 40mm dia. GI pipe medium duty pipes hand railing 3 rows fixed to RCC 1:2:4 vibrated post of 150x150mm at bottom and 100x150mm at top, placed at 2 Mtrs. intervals for a height of 750mm including curing, painting GI pipes with two coats of anticorrosive steel paint over a primer coat etc. with all lead lift etc. (The rate per meter is for 3 rows of GI pipes and RCC post) :Top dome railing, Landing slab etc complete with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and fixing MS inspection door of size 60 cms x 60 cms, including MS frame made of 50x50x6mm angle, shutters made of 3mm thick MS sheets, with hinges, locking arrangements at top etc. including painting with anticorrosive approved paint etc. complete including all lead and lifts etc. For over head tanks upto 2.5 lakhs capacity. etc complete with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Ladder inside the container: Providing anodized aluminium ladder using 65mm x 32mm x 3.0mm ‘C’ section for ladder side channel x 25mm dia., flutal pipe for Rungs at 250mm c/c ladder fixed at an angle of 70 degrees to horizontal including necessary 25mm dia., G.I. shutters with necessary G.I. fasteners for bracing the ladders to the Tank walls to prevent buckling of the ladder with necessary (M-15) bed for embedding the ladder bottom complete. etc complete with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and fixing lightening arrestor with aluminium strip 25mm x 3mm size including finial and grounding, aluminium strip to be embeded in one of the columns in and independent GI conduit of 40mm dia. pipe suitably jointed by collars with all specials with all lead and lifts etc. complete for:For Over Head Tanks upto 9 M staging  etc complete with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and laying water proofing treatment to the Water tanks & Liquid Retaining structures with two component acrylic polymer modified cementitious waterproofing membrane with minimum elongation of 50%  applied @ 1.5 kg/m2  for internal side waterproofing in two layers with  waiting period of 4-6 hrs per layer and food grade epoxy coating in two coats certified by CFTRI Mysuru, including surface preparation completely as per specification. etc complete with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.

Finishing walls with Acrylic Smooth exterior paint of required shade :New work (Two coat applied @ 1.67L/10 m² over and including priming coat of exterior primer applied @ 2.20 kg/10 m²) with paint of approved quality to give an even shade, after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.,Top dome, Top Ring Beam,Outside wall. etc complete with all lead and lifts and loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer incharge of the work.
